vo: Your phone buzzes with order requests at 2 am.
Clients expect instant replies, not a next‑day callback.
A buyer texts: Do you have 500 units today?
Our AI replies: Yes, stock ready, invoice sent.
The response updates your email, ERP system, and WhatsApp confirmation.
Now you have a 24/7 order assistant handling everything.
reel.insight_note: Today's wholesalers face growing order volume and need instant processing to stay competitive.
reel.caption:
Ever felt overwhelmed by late‑night order messages? Wholesalers lose sales when replies lag. With AI, every inquiry gets an instant, accurate reply and updates your systems automatically. Tip: set up a simple auto‑reply template today to acknowledge orders instantly. Save this Reel and share it with a fellow manufacturer. DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15‑min call.
